1. MJ 原图（「1 生成提示词」测量过会自动带过来）+ GPT 输出（下载的:
1. MJ original (carried over automatically after measuring in “1 Generate prompt”) + GPT output (the downloaded PNG, not a screenshot). The mask is usually not needed.
2. “What GPT did” is preset from page 1's record. For head / full character swaps: looks and outfit follow GPT; hair colour, skin tone, lip colour and softness are restored from the original MJ person, and the result is not added to calibration.
3. “Face brightness follows MJ”: 0 = keep the new GPT face's own brightness, 100 = as bright as the original MJ face. The lit / shaded modelling of the face is kept.
4. Restore mode: if GPT changed little, use “Replace changed areas only” (keeps the most MJ pixels, and GPT's outpainted edges too); if GPT changed a lot, use “Transfer style to whole image” (sharpest).
工具把每一组「交给 GPT 的图 + GPT 的输出」记下来，统计 GPT 每次:
The tool records every pair of “image given to GPT + GPT output” and works out how GPT drifts every time, e.g. midtones always shift towards blue, grain always drops, images always get sharper. Only drifts where at least 80% of the pairs agree in direction and the size is large enough are used for the anti-drift lines in the prompt and for the pre-compensated image.
More pairs means better accuracy; aim for 5 or more on this PC. Turn on “Add to calibration automatically” in “2 Restore” and every restore is added for you — you don't need to come here.
